//: Settings of tool/kit/check_structure.dart (docs/RULES.md F1, F2, F8, F10, F11, F12, F17). A key that starts with // is a comment. Change a setting on purpose, with the reason in docs/DECISIONS.md.
//limits: F1 limits in counted lines: blank lines and comment-only lines do not count. Keep them equal to docs/RULES.md.
//controllersDir: The folder of the ChangeNotifier controllers in presentation/. Older apps call it bloc: set "bloc" there rather than moving every file at once.
//coreFolders: Folders allowed under lib/core/ (a file may sit in one of them or below it). A new kind of shared code gets a folder here only with the owner's yes.
//featureFolders: Folders allowed under lib/features/<feature>/, besides presentation/<controllersDir>/ and the <feature>_routes.dart file.
//libFiles: Files allowed directly in lib/ (* matches any part of a name). Everything else goes under lib/core/ or lib/features/.
//generated: Generated files: never checked, and left out of the F17 line counts. **/ matches any folders, * any part of a name.
//sizeExceptions: Old files tolerated over the F1 limits until someone splits them; only a file that was already too big when these rules arrived gets an entry. Each entry: {"path": "lib/features/orders/presentation/pages/orders_page.dart", "reason": "why it is tolerated and who splits it", "maxLines": 900}. maxLines is optional: the file fails once it grows past it. An entry that is no longer needed is reported, so remove it.
//rules: Switch a check off with false: a family ("F11") or one check ("F2-import"). Checks: F1-file, F1-function, F1-build, F1-exception, F2-folder, F2-suffix, F2-name, F2-import, F8-color, F10-icon, F11-text, F12-helper, F17-budget. Off means the rule is wrong for this project: say why in docs/DECISIONS.md.
